Attached: 1 image

My Q4_K_M Qwen3-0.6B writes `return True` where BF16 writes `return False`. So I built heterodyne: it diffs two llama.cpp runs token by token and layer by layer, then writes one run's residual stream into the other to find which layers, and now which attention or MLP blocks, carry the difference. Local, CPU only, Rust.

https://github.com/zaydmulani09/heterodyne
